is_audit.description: Is this a clinical audit or audit-based quality improvement project measured against a standard?

topic.description: Short reusable topic name shared by audits of the same thing, e.g. 'Operation note quality'

standard.description: The guideline or standard audited against, with the target if stated

dates.description: Data collection period as stated, or 'not reported'

sample_size.description: Number of patients/cases/notes as digits, or 'not reported'

result.description: Main result against the standard WITH the numbers (percentages, counts, times), or 'not reported'
